description: Create the durable podcast task schema and pure submission/metadata security boundary that later worker and HTTP features consume. This feature leaves normal ArticleCollectionService collection behavior intact.
steps: Extend Article and CollectionTask in /usr/Project/article_collection_django/articles/models.py: add xiaoyuzhou, widen URL fields to 2048, make CollectionTask.article SET_NULL, add task type/owner/progress/error/retry/lease/cancel/URL-lock/billing fields and status choices, indexes, and the active podcast conditional URL-key constraint.

Add PodcastEpisode, PodcastTaskEvent, PodcastAsrAttempt, PodcastTranscriptSegment, PodcastAnalysisChunk, and PodcastAnalysisRollup models with the exact one-to-one/FK deletion policies, audit fields, uniqueness constraints, private-field boundaries, and no persisted provider JSON or audio archive.

Create /usr/Project/article_collection_django/articles/migrations/0007_podcast_collection.py dependent on 0006_weeklydigest_stat. It must backfill existing article tasks safely and only add/alter schema, constraints, and indexes without rewriting existing Article, weekly digest, or subscriber data.

Create /usr/Project/article_collection_django/articles/podcast.py with normalize_xiaoyuzhou_episode_url, PodcastSubmissionService, safe event/state helpers, and PodcastMetadataService.normalize_and_validate. Submission must be short-transaction-only, canonicalize accepted episodes, preserve the active URL lock under race, apply owner/staff visibility semantics, and create task/Episode/first event without external I/O.

Create /usr/Project/article_collection_django/articles/podcast_metadata_adapter.py as a safe CLI adapter: import the configured fetch_episode.py parse() with importlib, emit exactly one compact whitelisted JSON object, and map adapter errors without echoing external data or exceptions.

Create /usr/Project/article_collection_django/articles/test_podcast_collection.py with TestCase and migration-executor coverage for model defaults/relations/constraint, URL normalization, submission duplicate/race behavior, metadata normalization, and adapter output/error boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Migration from 0006 safely maps historical CollectionTask rows to article defaults and keeps existing data relations valid.
Exactly one active task can hold a canonical episode URL, historical Article duplicates are rejected, same owner/staff can retrieve its task, and other users receive only a generic conflict.
Only an exact http(s) xiaoyuzhoufm.com or www.xiaoyuzhoufm.com /episode/<1-200 [A-Za-z0-9_-]> URL becomes the canonical HTTPS www URL; all other values remain outside the podcast pipeline.
Paid, private, malformed, or unsafe metadata cannot be mistaken for free playable content, and adapter failures do not expose URL, body, exception, or credential data.
